headline: Consumer lending laws reformed for simpler, clearer rules
caption: Big changes are coming to how lenders operate in NZ! The Financial Markets Authority is taking over consumer credit oversight with new rules designed to be simpler and more workable. If you're thinking about a mortgage or refinancing in East Auckland, this means clearer lending practices and potentially smoother approval processes ahead. 🏡
original_title: Latest changes to consumer lending laws pass through Parliament
